accounts.create.description: Create a Postalytics sub-account. Returns the new account id and API key. Maps to POSTALYTICS_ADD_ACCOUNT.

address_city.description: City associated with the account address.

address_state.description: State associated with the account address.

address_street.description: Street address associated with the account.

address_zip.description: Zip code associated with the account address.

company.description: Company name associated with the account.

email_address.description: Email address associated with the account.

first_name.description: The first name of the account holder.

last_name.description: The last name of the account holder.

password.description: Account password. Minimum 8 characters including 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 number, and 1 special character.

phone.description: Phone number associated with the account.

accounts.create.title: Create account

accounts.delete.description: Delete a Postalytics sub-account or sub-user by id. Parent accounts cannot be deleted. Maps to POSTALYTICS_DELETE_ACCOUNT.

templates.create.description: Create a postcard or letter template from HTML or front/back image URLs. Maps to POSTALYTICS_CREATE_TEMPLATE.

back.description: URL for the full-sized back image or letter back content.

font_family.description: CSS font family, for example sans-serif.

front.description: URL for the full-sized front image or letter front content.

html.description: Complete HTML markup for the template when is_full_html is true.

is_double_sided.description: Whether a letter template is double-sided.

is_full_html.description: If true, html is complete markup. If false, use front and back image URLs.

is_proofed.description: If true, skip web-app proofing safeguards.

size.description: Template size. 0=letter, 1=4x6 postcard, 2=6x9 postcard, 3=6x11 postcard, 6=12x9 bifold, 7=6x18 bifold.

template_id.description: Template id. Returned on GET, not required for POST.

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail path of the template front.

thumbnail_back.description: Thumbnail path of the template back.
